# rom-weaver

> A local-first ROM toolkit. Apply and create patches, identify files, extract or compress ROMs, share bundles, bake supported cheats, and edit game saves in the browser or CLI. The browser also plays supported games. Files stay on-device without uploads or accounts.

## Markdown pages

The homepage and published tool pages have Markdown alternatives at `/index.md` and the tool path followed by `.md`. HTML pages advertise their Markdown URL with an alternate link.

- [Homepage](https://rom-weaver.com/index.md): Markdown summary and documentation link.

## Web app

- [Apply ROM patches](https://rom-weaver.com/apply-patches): Apply BPS, IPS, IPS32, UPS, xdelta, VCDIFF, PPF, APS, RUP, and other supported patches with format detection and ordered patch chains.
- [Create ROM patches](https://rom-weaver.com/create-patch): Create patches with format-aware settings and distributable bundles.
- [Compress files](https://rom-weaver.com/compress): Convert ISO or BIN/CUE to CHD, GameCube and Wii ISO to RVZ, and Nintendo 3DS ROMs to Z3DS; create ZIP or 7z archives.
- [Extract files](https://rom-weaver.com/extract): Decompress Z3DS, ZCCI, ZCXI, ZCIA, Z3DSX, CHD, RVZ, and supported archives locally in the browser.
- [Checksum a file](https://rom-weaver.com/checksum): Calculate CRC32, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and other checksums of any file, with optional archive extraction, and compare them with an expected value.
- [Identify a ROM](https://rom-weaver.com/identify-rom): Match a ROM's game, region, revision, and known dump name by checksum, locally in the browser.
- [Documentation](https://rom-weaver.com/docs): Tutorials, how-to guides, reference tables, and explanation, for the browser app and the CLI.
- [Use MCP and browser agents](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/use-mcp): Connect an MCP client for public documentation and formats, or use WebMCP workflows with browser approval.
- [What rom-weaver supports](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/features): Plain-language feature map, browser and CLI availability, and links to exact support limits.
- [Guided practice runs](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/guided-runs): Every guided browser run, its steps and practice files, where each starts, and every way files get into Apply.
- [Identify ROMs in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/identify-roms-browser): Look up files, search names or checksums, and compare fingerprints.
- [Checksum files in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/checksum-roms-browser): Calculate and compare any file's checksums locally.
- [Extract files in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/extract-files-browser): Take files out of an archive or disc image and download them singly or as one ZIP.
- [Compress files in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/convert-roms-browser): Package files or compress compatible disc images without applying a patch.
- [Convert RVZ to ISO in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/convert-rvz-to-iso): Extract a GameCube or Wii RVZ disc image to ISO on your device.
- [Convert ISO or BIN/CUE to CHD in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/convert-to-chd): Compress a supported disc image to CHD without applying a patch.
- [Convert CHD to ISO or BIN/CUE in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/extract-files-browser#convert-chd-to-iso-or-bincue): Extract DVD CHDs to ISO, CD CHDs to BIN/CUE, and Dreamcast GD-ROM CHDs to GDI and tracks.
- [Convert ISO to RVZ in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/convert-to-rvz): Compress a GameCube or Wii disc image to RVZ with the Compress tool.
- [Compress Nintendo 3DS ROMs to Z3DS in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/convert-to-z3ds): Create Z3DS, ZCCI, ZCXI, ZCIA, or Z3DSX files from uncompressed Nintendo 3DS inputs.
- [Extract Z3DS files in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/extract-z3ds): Decompress Z3DS, ZCCI, ZCXI, ZCIA, and Z3DSX files to their underlying Nintendo 3DS formats.
- [Trim ROMs in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/trim-roms-browser): Remove supported padding and download a separate copy.
- [Undo PPF in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/undo-ppf-browser): Restore bytes recorded in a PPF3 patch with undo data.
- [Settings and offline use](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/browser-settings): Preferences, beta tools, offline preparation, and local storage.
- [Markdown documentation index](https://rom-weaver.com/docs.md): Generated Markdown index for every published documentation page.
- [Your first patch](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/get-started): Tutorial that patches a homebrew ROM in the browser and verifies the result.
- [Apply patches guide](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/apply-rom-patches): Browser instructions for supported byte-level patch families, including SOLID, GDIFF, APSGBA, PAT/FireFlower, EBP, BDF/BSDIFF40, BSP, MOD/PMSR, DLDI, DPS, and single-file HDiffPatch/HPatchZ. NINJA1 and PDS cannot be applied.
- [Apply Dreamcast DCP patches (CLI)](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/cli-apply#apply-a-dreamcast-dcp-patch): Rebuild a Dreamcast disc from one DCP patch and its CUE or GDI input. DCP must run alone and is unavailable in browser Apply.
- [Use cheats guide](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/use-cheats): Bake ROM cheats into a ROM from the browser Apply workflow.
- [Create patches guide](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/create-rom-patches): Compare Original and Modified, create a patch, then test the downloaded artifact.
- [Create bundles guide](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/create-bundles): Build, download, test, and publish a patch-only bundle in the browser's Apply workflow.
- [Test ROMs guide](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/test-roms): Play a local ROM or an Apply result in the browser with local saves.
- [FAQ](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/faq): Common questions, each pointing at the page that owns the answer.
- [How patching works](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/how-patching-works): Why the exact starting file matters, what a checksum proves, and why patch order matters.
- [Why files stay on your device](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/local-first): How local-first processing works in the browser and what it costs.
- [What a bundle is](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/bundles): The portable patch recipe, what it contains, and when to make one.
- [Browser and CLI](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/browser-and-cli): One engine, two front ends, and how to choose.
- [Identify data sources](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/identify-sources): How pinned Libretro and OpenGood data provides local ROM identification.
- [Comparison with similar tools](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/comparisons): Workflow trade-offs between rom-weaver, RomPatcher.js, Flips, MultiPatch, xdelta3, chdman, and Dolphin tool.
- [CHD, RVZ, ZIP, and 7z speed benchmarks](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/performance): Recorded native CLI timings against chdman, dolphin-tool, 7zz, and Info-ZIP, with versions, inputs, settings, and limits. These are not browser, Z3DS, or patching competitor benchmarks.
- [Compression formats guide](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/compression-formats): Pick format-specific compression such as CHD, RVZ, or Z3DS, plus ZIP and 7z, and learn when trimming beats compressing.
- [Install the CLI](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/install): Install rom-weaver with package managers, verified scripts, npm, Docker, or from source.
- [Verify a download](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/verify-downloads): Check that a release archive, npm package, or container image carries the repository's build provenance.
- [Your first apply in the terminal](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/cli-get-started): Tutorial covering Apply, Create, and Bundle in the terminal with the same test assets.
- [Identify and hash ROMs (CLI)](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/identify-and-hash-files): Match an exact dump name, inspect a file, or compute checksums.
- [Bake cheat codes (CLI)](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/bake-cheat-codes): Write Game Genie, GameShark/Pro Action Replay, or supported Xploder codes permanently into a ROM.
- [Edit a game save (CLI)](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/cli-save): Inspect a supported save, preview changes, and write an edited copy.
- [Trim a ROM (CLI)](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/cli-trim): Trim, preview, and revert ROM padding from the command line.
- [Work with archives](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/work-with-archives): Extract, convert, and create ZIP and 7z archives from the command line.
- [CLI reference](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/cli): Every command, global flag, patching flag, JSON output, exit codes, and man pages.
- [Supported formats](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/supported-formats): Patch, container, codec, checksum, trim, header, and browser emulator support.
- [Cheat database](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/cheat-database): Supported systems, matching, delivery classes, offline behavior, and licensing.
- [Save Editor support](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/game-save-support): Supported games, editable fields, recognition rules, and integrity checks.
- [Self-hosting](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/self-hosting): Deploy and configure the static webapp.
- [Architecture](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/architecture): Understand the Rust command core, browser workers, and TypeScript boundary.
- [Edit a game save in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/edit-gen3-saves): Inspect a supported game save, preview changes, download a copy, and test it with a matching ROM.
- [Create game saves in the browser](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/create-game-saves-browser): Generate fresh Zelda saves and edit their properties before download.
- [Create game saves with the CLI](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/create-game-saves-cli): Generate fresh saves or validated copies from existing save templates.
- [Save Editor development](https://rom-weaver.com/docs/game-save-development): Shared save handler architecture, integrity boundary, and contributor flow.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/README.md): Every page, grouped as tutorials, how-to guides, reference, and explanation.
- [Install the CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/how-to/install-cli.md): Package managers, verified install scripts, npm, Docker, and source builds.
- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/reference/cli.md): Commands, global flags, JSON output, exit codes, permissions, and completions.
- [Supported formats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/reference/formats.md): Patch, container, codec, checksum, trim, and header support tables.
- [Save Editor support](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/reference/save-editor.md): Supported games, fields, recognition rules, and integrity checks.
- [Web app integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/hosting/webapp-integration.md): Preloaded URLs and same-origin OPFS integration.
- [Self-hosting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/hosting/self-hosting.md): Docker, static hosting, reverse proxies, subpaths, HTTPS, and browser isolation headers.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/development/ARCHITECTURE.md): Crate graph, registries, browser workers, OPFS, and the Rust-TypeScript boundary.
- [Edit a game save in the browser](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/how-to/edit-gen3-saves.md): Recognition, editing, previews, downloads, and testing with a matching ROM.
- [Save Editor development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/docs/development/save-editor.md): Handler architecture, integrity rules, and the eight-step contributor flow.
- [Release guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rom-weaver/rom-weaver/main/.github/RELEASING.md): Release automation, publishing channels, and retry procedures.
